release_notes_zh:
新增
- 命令行工具 truerespi：list 扫描、crop 文件夹批量导出，支持每小时 TXT
- MCP 服务 truerespi-mcp：新增 list_recordings / crop_export，可接入 Agent
- install.ps1：命令行下载、校验 SHA256、静默安装与卸载

改进
- 安装时自动把安装目录下的 bin 加入 PATH，卸载时移除
- 批量导出单个文件失败不中断，结果包含 failed / warnings
- 命令行与桌面共用流式裁剪核心

修复
- 修复「编辑 → 配色方案」等二级菜单被父级容器裁切
- 修复 Y 轴手动调整与自动跟随互相抢占

注意事项
- 安装包未做商业代码签名，SmartScreen 提示时请核对 SHA256
- TXT 每小时约 50–70 MB（1 kHz 单通道）
- 覆盖安装会保留 %APPDATA%\TrueRespi 中的用户数据
release_notes_en:
New
- CLI truerespi: list recordings and crop whole folders into hourly TXT
- MCP server truerespi-mcp: new list_recordings / crop_export tools
- install.ps1: download, SHA256 verification, silent install and uninstall

Improved
- The installer adds {app}\bin to PATH and removes it on uninstall
- Folder exports continue when one file fails and report failed / warnings
- CLI and desktop share the same streaming crop core

Fixed
- Secondary menus (Edit -> Color scheme) were clipped by the parent scroll container
- Manual Y adjustments fought with persistent auto-fit

Notes
- The installer is not commercially code-signed; verify SHA256 if SmartScreen warns
- Hourly TXT is roughly 50-70 MB (1 kHz, single channel)
- In-place upgrade preserves user data under %APPDATA%\TrueRespi
